plot-title: Borough words that three models share
plot-caption: The top words of contrast C3 at the cool token, by relative depth, for Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B. C3 is a Welch t over NTAs of one borough against the rest. Words are ranked by their lowest z-score over the three models, thus a word ranks high only when all three models raise it.
